summary: P2 delivers its outcome: the prd storage release creates backup-reader and its Secret, and runs a Forbid, 2 h-bounded s3-mirror CronJob. The CronJob mirrors every -prd-owned bucket through a crypt remote, archives replaced and deleted objects per run and keeps 30 archive folders. The dev render is unchanged and nothing under terraform-modules/ or _providers/ changes. One advisory Minor finding.

findings.summary: keepArchives: 0 prunes nothing (folders[:-0] is empty) instead of keeping no archive folders
